name: Build: Particles and a colour-grade hook
body: Particles (dust, sparks, trails) and a per-chapter colour grade that Nyx can set, for the Crimson and Thorn chapter looks. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Colour grade hook done (D-071): lantern::graphics::SetColorGrade, guide docs/colour-grade.md. Particles are still to do; this card stays open for them.
